PresentationMode__SceneGroups__Descripti: Configuration for the Presentation Mode scene grouping system. Holds the default group set seeded into a project that has none, plus the behaviour flags for the floating group selector that sits above the scene carousel. Per-project group definitions live in the project's own TrueVision__ProjectData__.json, nested inside PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes.

PresentationMode__SceneGroups__Behaviour.SceneGroups__Behaviour__Description: Runtime behaviour of the group selector bar and the carousel filtering it drives.

PresentationMode__SceneGroups__Labels.SceneGroups__Labels__Description: All user-facing wording for the group selector bar. Group names themselves are per-project and authored in the Dev menu.
PresentationMode__SceneGroups__Labels.SceneGroups__Labels__EmptyGroupMessage: No scenes in this group yet.

PresentationMode__SceneGroups__DevMenu.SceneGroups__DevMenu__Description: Wording used by the localhost-only group editor nested at the top of the Dev menu Presentation Scenes panel.
PresentationMode__SceneGroups__DevMenu.SceneGroups__DevMenu__DisableWithScenesP: "{group}" still has {count} scene(s). Switching it off will move them to "{fallback}". Continue?
PresentationMode__SceneGroups__DevMenu.SceneGroups__DevMenu__DeleteWithScenesPr: Delete "{group}"? Its {count} scene(s) will move to "{fallback}".
PresentationMode__SceneGroups__DevMenu.SceneGroups__DevMenu__LastGroupBlockedMe: At least one scene group must stay enabled.
